name: The House
tagline: The file is the save. Tap to look. Find the way out.
description:
Works offline. The room you reached and the things in your tray live in this file — close it, copy it, come back, and you are still in that corridor, still holding the note. No account, no install, no Flash.

You wake in a room you do not know. The plant is too small. There is a note on the desk. The corridor goes further than it should.

This is a short point-and-click walking-sim. Tap or click a thing to walk over and look at it. Tap a door to try it. Picked-up things sit in the tray at the edge of the screen — open the tray and use them on the world. Drag the room if the view is larger than the screen. Mute is the speaker in the corner. Reset starts from the first room.

On a phone the same tap hits the note, the door, the window. There is no hover and no Flash plugin.

An unofficial port of The House by Artur Kot. The rooms, art, and sounds are his. This copy keeps your progress in the file.
